purpose: One-time fresh out-of-sample test of the already-frozen 15m/30m Severity ordering plus symmetric Platt calibration. No model, feature, threshold, calibration, horizon, cutoff, or acceptance-gate fitting is allowed after this preregistration.

fresh_oos_window.reason: Last completed trading day before preregistration on 2026-09-14; later 2026 observations may not be added to rescue or strengthen the test.

canonical_data_readiness.source_ref_selection_rule: Before any 2026 row-level scientific read, pin one immutable commit containing both required 2026 paths; all previously frozen 2020-2025 canonical shard identities must match the Phase-1 canonical manifest exactly.
canonical_data_readiness.staging_rule: After a qualifying immutable commit is pinned, a transport-only stage may materialize only rows with trading_day <= 2026-09-11 for scientific compute; staging must not calculate outcomes or acceptance metrics.

fresh_oos_acceptance_gates_per_horizon: family-adjusted trading-day bootstrap lower bound for raw-score AUROC gain > 0
fresh pooled calibrated Brier gain B-minus-C > 0
fresh pooled calibrated LogLoss gain B-minus-C > 0
each symbol calibrated Brier gain >= 0 and calibrated LogLoss gain >= 0

verdicts.FRESH_OOS_SUPPORTED: All frozen support and acceptance gates pass for the horizon.
verdicts.FRESH_OOS_NOT_SUPPORTED: Support is adequate but one or more frozen scientific acceptance gates fail.
verdicts.INSUFFICIENT_2026_SUPPORT: One or more frozen support gates fail; this does not authorize extending the cutoff or changing the model.

authority_after_result.if_supported: Severity may be promoted from descriptive diagnostic to research-supported 15m/30m Layer2 probability component, subject to separate Layer3 integration research and still with production_authority=false.
authority_after_result.if_not_supported: Severity remains non-authoritative for Layer2 probability decisions; no rescue retuning on revealed 2026 is allowed.
authority_after_result.if_insufficient_support: 2026 is considered revealed once evaluated; extending the window requires a new preregistration and may not be represented as the original fresh OOS test.
